_comment: Analytically-initialised parameters for the 8-state opponent HMM. NO training is performed (no ground-truth SoC/ERS labels exist publicly). Values are domain-knowledge priors in the spirit of arXiv:2603.01290 Tables 1/2/8, and are exposed here so the belief can be re-derived under different assumptions. Hidden state = (ERS in {H, M, Lharvest, Lderate}) x (Overtake in {available, spent}).

transitions._comment: Row-stochastic over the 4 ERS bins, per lap. Asymmetry is deliberate: Lharvest can return to M/H once the driver burns the built-up reserve, Lderate cannot bypass recovery (it must harvest first).

emissions._comment: Gaussian emissions: mean/sigma per ERS bin. Bernoulli for zaero (inferred Active Aero low-drag state).

dv_trap_kph._comment: Speed-trap delta vs the circuit baseline for that car. Strongly negative when the rival is empty (Lderate) or saving (Lharvest); near zero when the battery is healthy.

delta_throttle._comment: Fraction of the straight spent at full throttle while the speed is flat or falling (super-clipping fraction). THE discriminator between Lharvest (low) and Lderate (high).

delta_bbrake_m._comment: Brake-point delta vs baseline [m]. Harvesting cars brake earlier to lengthen the recovery window.

speed_variance._comment: Variance of the speed trace over the straight. Low when the car is pinned at a cap (clipping / aero limited).

zaero._comment: P(inferred Active Aero in low-drag Straight Mode) - Bernoulli. A harvesting car that still runs low drag is the counter-harvest trap signature.

trap._comment: Counter-harvest trap: rival looks slow but is deliberately harvesting while running low-drag aero. Threshold on the HMM posterior.
